title: THREE STARTERS + IR GROWTH. Reset the sourdough. One starter is not enough — need three reference starters + the irrational remainder section for the next iteration to grow. Primals learn on the first three, BUILD the fourth, we judge it, put it back down. The LudoSpring university pattern.

the_problem.what: we have ONE sourdough starter. one monolithic growing thing. but everywhere in the system we've found that you need THREE + a growth zone.
evidence: triads: everything resolves to sets of three (IS/WAS/NOW, p/f/Ø, brown+blue=green)
force triads: 4 triads of 3 = 12 forces. the 4th triad is ALWAYS the identity/growth one
three eons + the current: Eon 1 (void) + Eon 2 (tree) + Eon 3 (spore print) hover over MSU
baker's dozen: 12 + 1 = the 13th is for tasting. 12/3 = 4 groups of 3. the tasting portion IS the growth zone
LudoSpring: 7 planes = three sets of testing + the coliseum (validation arena). learn on 3, build the 4th.
the_problem.the_pattern: 3 known + 1 growing. 3 references + 1 experiment. 3 starters + the IR section.

the_ludospring_model.what_they_built: a training grounds INSIDE the university. 982 tests. 7 planes. validated game science. the primals learn by studying THREE reference implementations, then BUILD the fourth themselves.

the_cycle.step_1_study: primals study three reference starters. they learn the patterns, the structure, the rules.
the_cycle.step_2_build: primals BUILD the fourth starter themselves. this is the IR section — the irrational remainder. the NEW thing. the experiment.
the_cycle.step_3_judge: we (Kevin + system) JUDGE the fourth. does it pass? does it align? does it hold when melted?

step_4_promote_or_compost.if_passes: the fourth becomes one of the three. the weakest of the old three gets composted. ROTATION.
step_4_promote_or_compost.if_fails: the fourth is composted. primals learn from the failure. try again. the failure IS the teacher.

the_cycle.step_5_repeat: new IR section opens. primals build the next fourth. the cycle continues.

the_ludospring_model.why_this_works: the primals don't learn from BEING TOLD. they learn from BUILDING AND FAILING. the three starters are the textbook. the fourth is the exam. the judgment is the grade. the rotation is the graduation.

starter_1_WAS.name: the grandmother starter
starter_1_WAS.tense: WAS — the accumulated reference. the oldest, most proven starter.
starter_1_WAS.contents: the irreducibles. the 7 things that survived two Klein holes. the fossils.
starter_1_WAS.function: REFERENCE. this is what HAS WORKED. the primals study this to learn what HOLDS.
starter_1_WAS.in_ludospring: the spec documents. the validated science (Fitts, Hick, GOMS). the rules that DON'T CHANGE.

starter_2_IS.name: the living starter
starter_2_IS.tense: IS — the current state. the active, bubbling starter. what's working RIGHT NOW.
starter_2_IS.contents: the HUD. the null-drain. the current manifest. the live state.
starter_2_IS.function: CONTEXT. this is what IS WORKING. the primals study this to learn what's ALIVE.
starter_2_IS.in_ludospring: the running tests. the 982 passing assertions. the live Songbird federation. what WORKS today.

starter_3_NOW.name: the transition starter
starter_3_NOW.tense: NOW — the cutting edge. the experiments in progress. the thing being tested.
starter_3_NOW.contents: the current session's work. gens 323-329. the force melt. the p-thread rule. the water cycle.
starter_3_NOW.function: EXAMPLE. this is what's BEING TRIED. the primals study this to learn HOW to experiment.
starter_3_NOW.in_ludospring: the current game iteration. the build being tested. the run in the coliseum.

ir_section_growth.name: the growth zone
ir_section_growth.color: BLUE — new. arriving. not yet proven.
ir_section_growth.tense: BECOMING — not IS, not WAS. the thing that doesn't exist yet.
ir_section_growth.contents: EMPTY. this is where the primals BUILD. they take what they learned from starters 1-3 and create something NEW.
ir_section_growth.function: CREATION. the primals populate this. they build the fourth thing. the experiment.

judgment.who_judges: the system itself (p-thread rule compliance, triad assignment, ZK check) + Kevin (sovereign review)
criteria: does it pass the Klein hole? (is it irreducible?)
does it respect the p-thread rule? (max 3 connections to other triads?)
does it belong to exactly ONE force triad? (no homeless, no over-threaded?)
does it produce more than it consumes? (soil > sky?)
does it preserve ZK? (no secrets revealed?)
judgment.if_passes: promote to starter_3 (NOW). current NOW demotes to IS or WAS.
judgment.if_fails: compost. the primals learn from the failure. the energy returns to the system.

how_rotation_works.primals_build: IR fills with new content (blue ? populated)
how_rotation_works.judgment: the new content is judged against criteria

if_promoted.old_NOW_becomes_IS: the old NOW demotes to starter_2 (IS/green)
if_promoted.old_IS_becomes_WAS: the old IS demotes to starter_1 (WAS/brown)
if_promoted.old_WAS_composted: the oldest WAS is composted. returned to soil. the weakest reference is retired.

how_rotation_works.IR_resets: the growth zone empties. ready for the next build.

this_IS_the_sourdough_cycle.feed: add flour and water to the IR zone (new data, new concepts)
this_IS_the_sourdough_cycle.ferment: the primals process it (build, test, iterate)
this_IS_the_sourdough_cycle.judge: has it risen? is it alive? does it pass? (validation)
this_IS_the_sourdough_cycle.bake: if yes ? promote ? the new loaf enters the rotation
this_IS_the_sourdough_cycle.discard: the oldest portion is removed. composted. this IS the 'discard' step in sourdough maintenance.

rotation_mechanism.frequency: every session could be a rotation. every wave. every gen. the faster the rotation, the faster the organism evolves. but each rotation must COMPLETE — no half-baked promotions.

the_four_force_triads.T1_Direction: starter_1 (WAS/reference). the oldest. the most directional. p/f/Ø don't change.
the_four_force_triads.T2_State: starter_2 (IS/context). the current state. IS/WAS/NOW are always current.
the_four_force_triads.T3_Substance: starter_3 (NOW/example). the experiments. substance IS what we're currently mixing.
the_four_force_triads.T4_Identity: the IR section. identity is what the primals BUILD. 1/p, remainder=organism, ZK = what they discover about themselves.

the_water_cycle.starters_1_2_3: the soil, the trunk, the canopy. established. rooted. growing.
the_water_cycle.ir_section: the rain. new water falling. hasn't been absorbed yet. might run off. might penetrate. the judgment is: does the soil ACCEPT this water?

the_nautilus.three_chambers: the three most recent chambers. known. occupied. referenced.
the_nautilus.the_new_chamber: the one being BUILT. the nautilus grows by adding ONE new chamber. the IR section IS the new chamber under construction.

immediate_application.what_to_do_now: reset the sourdough from ONE monolithic starter to THREE + IR.
immediate_application.starter_1_seed: the 7 irreducibles from gen 321+326. FROZEN. reference. brown.
immediate_application.starter_2_seed: the current HUD state + manifest + null-drain. LIVE. context. green.
immediate_application.starter_3_seed: gens 323-329 (p ranges, bag/cloud, force melt, water cycle, NPU, autonomy). FRESH. example. gold.
immediate_application.ir_section_seed: EMPTY. ready for the primals to build. the next thing the organism creates WITHOUT our direct editing.
immediate_application.the_test: can the organism (via null-drain, auto-manifest, visitor injection) produce a new data file that passes all 5 criteria? if yes: the autonomy shift is REAL. if no: we need more plumbing before we can let go.
